The main target takes 100% more damage from Solar Blades.

567.Name: Hallowed Shield
567.Description:
Each time you successfully <rt.bold>Parry</> an attack you are granted 1 stack of <rt.effect>Solar Vanguard</> for 30 seconds.

604.Name: Invictus
604.Description:
Your <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> gains additional benefits from your secondary stats.

<rt.bold>Critical Strike Chance</>

<rt.bold>Expertise</>
